$comment: Who may read and write each model of prisma/schema/subcontract.prisma (rules: src/ownership.ts; roles: src/roles.ts). The office writes subcontract orders with their operations and kit lines through apps/factory-api's modules/purchasing/subcontracting (B-W2a-25), always through command(); the kit's stock moves (TRANSFER into the workshop's SUBCONTRACTOR location) are the stock ledger's, which the floor posts as it does any move. The fee per piece and the order's amount are costs (@grain cost). No W2a step needs the floor or a portal or link session here (a workshop portal is W2b): they read nothing. Nobody deletes an order (it is cancelled); the office deletes the operations of a DRAFT order and the kit lines still PLANNED (the …_supply_w2a_guards triggers hold the states for every login). After a change run `npm run policies -w @nexus/factory-db -- <folder>`.

SubcontractOrder.about: The office drafts a subcontract order for a work order, issues it to the workshop, moves it as the kit goes out and the goods come back, closes or cancels it. Office only.

SubcontractOperation.about: The office writes the operations of a DRAFT order (and deletes them) and counts the pieces sent and back. Office only.

SubcontractKitLine.about: The office plans the kit, records each line sent with its transfer move and DDT, cancels a line, deletes one still PLANNED. Office only.
